summary: Entity disambiguation (mapping ambiguous mentions in text to entities in a knowledge base) is a foundational step in tasks such as knowledge graph construction, question answering, and information extraction. Recent work has applied LLMs to this problem, achieving stateof-the-art performance.
takeaways: The reasoning paradigm is trained with distillation and reinforcement learning recipes.
Recent work has applied LLMs to this problem, achieving stateof-the-art performance.
Notably, reasoning LLMs have been shown to perform entity disambiguation in a true zero-shot fashion, generalizing across knowledge bases and domains.
